messages.content:
A writer revised their English post sentence by sentence. Compare the version before the revision with the final one, as an editor protecting what the writer meant.

Before:
<<<
I’m on the early chapters of Darktail’s Judgment, and I get a little bit confused about why StarClan didn’t show up when Darkpaw was at the moonstone and he went really miserable and furious for that.

Ravenpaw said StarClan had travelled with the Clans and left the forest skies, and it would be hard / not worth it to get back here for a distant little kittypet who wanted to join the Clans. But it was mentioned in the book that it was an overcast day, so without the moonlight it makes sense they couldn’t reach StarClan back then when the Clans were still in the forest. (Could someone tell me if there was a similar case in the other books where the night sky was cloudy when some cat’s at the Moonstone? Or do StarClan have the power to clear the clouds if they want to communicate?)

And Darkpaw didn’t try again on a clear day; he just chose to transform himself into Darktail👿 instead.
>>>

Final:
<<<
I’m on the early chapters of Darktail’s Judgment, and I get a little bit confused about why StarClan didn’t show up when Darkpaw was at the moonstone and he went really miserable and furious for that.

Ravenpaw said StarClan had travelled with the Clans and left the forest skies, and it would be too hard to get back here for a distant little kittypet who wanted to join the Clans. But it was mentioned in the book that it was an overcast day, so without the moonlight it makes sense they couldn’t reach StarClan back then when the Clans were still in the forest. (Could someone tell me if there was a similar case in the other books where the night sky was cloudy when some cat’s at the Moonstone? Or do StarClan have the power to clear the clouds if they want to communicate?)

And Darkpaw didn’t try again on a clear day; he just chose to transform himself into Darktail👿 instead.
>>>

During the revision the writer confirmed what they meant at these places; changes that follow these are intended:
- 「hard / not worth it」→ StarClan could not easily come back

List only real problems in the final version: a point, detail, question or condition from before that is gone (lost); a claim whose meaning changed, e.g. a hedge or a hypothetical that became a flat statement (changed); text that appears twice (duplicated); a sentence that is broken where two pieces were joined (broken). Rewording, reordering and better phrasing are not problems. quote: the exact words from the final version (or, for lost, from before); note: one short English sentence to the writer, informal. [] if there is nothing.
Reply with JSON only: {"issues":[{"kind":"lost|changed|duplicated|broken","quote":"","note":""}]}
